observation: Ran: 1 planner, 10 builder rounds (red, green, 3 review-fix, search picker, 2 picker regressions, orphan deletion, docs, premise pin), 6 reviewer passes (5 returned blocking findings before the approving 6th pass), 3 desktop builds, 4 dev/desktop live-proof sessions. About 6 of 10 builder rounds were rework — fixes to earlier fix rounds or to the rejected UI control — and a large share of orchestrator time went to environment (dev-server harness detection, a desktop DB hang) rather than the outcome. Final diff: production +1201/-157 (net +1044), tests/stories +1728, docs +3.

Maintainer asked why a new search-and-pick UI was built when search is a solved pattern. Measured: no pick-a-task control existed on main, but the branch added a third copy of the fetch/abort search hook (no debounce) and a hand-rolled results listbox with no keyboard navigation, while GlobalSearchPanel already searches tasks with debounce and useKeyboardNavigation. Extracting a pick mode from global search was the extract-before-invent option; the plan was silent on it and no /design round ran.
Orchestrator left the BA6 registry row for the maintainer to update. Maintainer: maintaining pipeline status is entirely the orchestrator's job.

Orchestrator recorded 'the dev server reports harness readiness it cannot act on' as a defect for separate work. Maintainer: the web version works only with remote harnesses by design, local testing has none, and only the desktop build can exercise a harness — if it doesn't build, the change broke it. The proposed item was wrong and is withdrawn.
Orchestrator backed up, moved aside and restored the desktop database several times. Maintainer: it is a demo database to be refilled with demo data, not something to preserve.

Maintainer asked whether the design system already had a dropdown. It did: ds/RoleCombobox.tsx (filter input, listbox, full keyboard and aria-activedescendant). The branch's picker hand-rolled a listbox with no keyboard navigation — a CRITICAL finding under design-system.md 'Reuse before build' that the builder and six review passes missed. The orchestrator's own first remedy (extract a pick mode from global search) was also wrong; the fix was to generalize RoleCombobox into ds/Combobox and migrate AgentEditor onto it.
The fresh review of the rework found that Enter picked a stale, invisible result during the search debounce — a wrong dependency one fast keystroke away. Fixed with a red-first test.
Driving the running app found that after a failed search, retyping the same query never refetched, so the 'Please try again' error could not be acted on. The network log showed a single request.

The browser test pane reports document.visibilityState 'hidden': it pauses requestAnimationFrame (so focus moved on the next frame never arrived), drops the tool's key presses (Backspace, ArrowDown, Enter, Return had no effect while typed text did), and serves stale screenshots. Keyboard proof had to use in-page KeyboardEvents; DOM reads, not screenshots, were the source of truth.

Running a backend-editing builder concurrently with a live browser proof restarted the dev server mid-check; a search hit the restart (502) and cost several proof attempts before the cause was found in the server log.

After the first ship: 4 more builder rounds (combobox rebuild, comment trim, stale-pick + cleanups, plus the earlier id strip and inventory regen) and 3 more review passes. All of it traces to the skipped /design round and the missed design-system check, not to the outcome itself.
